literal: Sneeze when suppressing, she wept, 'Your people thinking, from us are you hiding?' saying.
translation: When I suppressed a sneeze, she wept, saying, "Are you hiding from me that your people are thinking of you?"
modern: நான் தும்மலை அடக்கியபோது, 'உம்முடைய உறவினர் உம்மை நினைப்பதை என்னிடமிருந்து மறைக்கிறீரோ?' என்று கூறி அவள் அழுதாள்.
explanation: This couplet relies on the traditional poetic belief that a sneeze indicates a loved one is thinking of the person sneezing. The hero, knowing his wife will assume another woman is thinking of him, tries to suppress his sneeze to avoid her jealousy. However, she notices him holding it back and bursts into tears anyway. She accuses him of hiding the sneeze because he wants to conceal that 'his people' (a sarcastic reference to other women) are thinking of him. The word 'நுமர்' (your people) perfectly captures her feigned anger, distancing herself from him by suggesting his true affections lie elsewhere.
